reason: The earlier framing, that the evaluation only reconstructs Pharos's own bookkeeping and does not ask for unseen-edge prediction, was withdrawn after reading the brief. Its Key Question asks whether an agent can build a contextualized graph that outperforms Pharos at predicting held-out links, and the Evaluation holds the model fixed on both graphs; only which edge type is held out remains unanswered in the Q&A. The correction also changed which experiment was decisive, from graph-size profiling to the fixed held-out comparison.
